description: This source file defines the internal class 'SiloConnectionMaintainer', which manages silo connections within the Orleans Runtime messaging infrastructure. It handles lifecycle participation, silo status change notifications, and connection cleanup tasks.

classes.name: SiloConnectionMaintainer
classes.description: Manages silo connections, responds to silo status changes, and participates in the runtime lifecycle within Orleans.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Handles startup, subscribing to silo status events.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Handles shutdown, unsubscribing from silo status events.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Registers this maintainer as a lifecycle participant with a specific stage.

methods.name: SiloStatusChangeNotification
methods.description: Responds to silo status changes, initiating connection cleanup if a silo is marked dead.

methods.name: CloseConnectionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously closes connections to a specified silo, including a delay for message flushing and error handling.
